title: WorkedGen interactive programming examples
summary: First-year Python students request or select a programming question and study an LLM-generated worked example one step at a time. They can ask follow-up questions or select code and keywords for explanations, then rate the resource's usefulness.

sources.title: Evaluating LLM-generated Worked Examples in an Introductory Programming Course
sources.evidence_quote: WorkedGen allows the user to enter a programming language and a question for which a worked example is generated.

assessment.summary: First-year Python students request or select a programming question and study an LLM-generated worked example one step at a time.
student_actions: Choose or enter a programming question.
Review an LLM-generated worked example step by step.
Ask follow-up questions about code or concepts.

student_role.description: They can ask follow-up questions or select code and keywords for explanations, then rate the resource's usefulness.
